description.zh: 把递归自我改进拆成能检查的系统问题：任务契约、独立评价、预算、候选搜索、血缘、经验更新和发布回滚。用20个CPU实验、20张流程图、3种交互演示和40道解析题，完成一份保留正负结果的工程作品。

title.zh: 原理：为什么需要这一层

body.zh: 先分清被优化的系统和提出优化的系统。把 batch 从 1 调到 2 是目标系统的改动；记录结果后修改下一轮候选的选择规则，才触及改进器本身。一次参数搜索成功不能证明系统会持续、普遍地自我改进。RSI Infra 要解决的是如何让多轮提案、执行、评估、保留与复用有可检查的状态。
body.en: Separate the target system from the system proposing changes. Changing batch size changes the target; revising the proposal rule using previous outcomes changes the improver. A successful parameter search does not establish sustained, general self-improvement. RSI infrastructure makes proposals, execution, evaluation, retention and reuse inspectable across rounds.

body.zh: 本课程用确定性配置提案器代替收费 LLM，用本机教学工作负载代替生产训练。你可以完整观察闭环，但它不是 InfraRSI、AlphaEvolve 或 DGM 的复现。读论文时比较三个问题：改了什么、谁判断有效、下一轮继承了什么；再记录论文结果与本站运行的证据边界。
body.en: This course uses a deterministic configuration proposer instead of a paid LLM and a local teaching workload instead of production training. You can inspect a complete loop, but it is not a reproduction of InfraRSI, AlphaEvolve or DGM. When reading a paper, ask what changed, who judged it and what the next round inherited; keep its reported results separate from your own runs.

body.zh: 原创算例：A 策略用 8 次尝试找到 1 个合格候选；B 也用 8 次找到 2 个。2/8 大于 1/8，只说明这批任务上通过率不同。要说改进器变好，还要在未参与策略选择的任务上、相同预算下复查。
body.en: Worked example: strategy A finds one acceptable candidate in eight attempts; B finds two in eight. The difference between 1/8 and 2/8 describes this task set only. To claim an improved improver, evaluate the strategies under equal budgets on tasks not used to select them.

body.zh: 任务契约定义固定输入语义、正确性条件、可改字段、指标和预算。先问“输出必须保持什么”，再问“怎样更快”。如果候选把结果少算一半，吞吐看似提高却违反任务。契约必须在搜索前确定，候选不能为了过关同时放宽误差或删掉困难输入。
body.en: A task contract fixes input semantics, correctness conditions, editable fields, metrics and budget. Specify what outputs must preserve before asking how to accelerate them. Omitting half the work may look faster while violating the task. Freeze the contract before search; a candidate cannot also relax tolerances or remove difficult inputs to pass.

body.zh: 把配置 schema 与评估器分开。候选只提交允许范围内的配置；控制器校验类型、上下界和字段白名单，再把它交给实现。实验中的白名单是教学接口，不等于对任意代码建立了安全沙箱。修改契约要生成新版本，不能继续与旧基线直接混算。
body.en: Separate the configuration schema from the evaluator. A candidate submits only permitted configuration fields; the controller validates types, bounds and names before execution. This allowlist is a teaching interface, not a sandbox for arbitrary code. A revised contract needs a new version and should not be silently compared with the old baseline.

body.zh: 设正确性阈值为绝对误差≤0.01，候选误差为0.03。即使耗时从100降到60，也应先判不合格；100/60≈1.67只是无效候选的速度比。

reading.title: scikit-learn · data leakage and common pitfalls

title.zh: 原理：为什么需要这一层

body.zh: 搜索会反复接触反馈，因此它接触过的数据不再是独立最终测试。区分用于提出候选的训练/搜索任务、选择策略的验证任务，以及只在冻结策略后评价的留出任务。这里是任务划分，不是在训练一个神经网络；概念同样适用于配置与程序搜索。
body.en: Repeated feedback makes searched examples unsuitable as independent final tests. Separate tasks for proposing candidates, validation tasks for strategy selection and holdout tasks used only after freezing the strategy. This is task partitioning rather than neural-network training; the distinction also matters for configuration and program search.

body.zh: 随机种子保证可重复划分，不自动保证无泄漏。同一请求的复制品、相同前缀族或同源任务可能跨集合重复。记录任务ID、内容摘要和分组规则，先查交集再运行。若已据留出结果改策略，该集合应被视为开发数据，重新准备最终评价。
body.en: A seed makes a split repeatable, not leakage-free. Copies, shared prefix families or related tasks may cross partitions. Record IDs, content digests and grouping rules, then check overlap before running. Once holdout outcomes guide a strategy revision, treat that set as development data and prepare a new final evaluation.

body.en: Optimization must preserve specified semantics. Compute expected outputs with an independent reference, then compare the candidate. If both share the same faulty function, agreement may conceal an error. Test empty inputs, repeats, boundary lengths, invalid configurations and cache invalidation as well as typical inputs.

body.zh: 误差检查需要说明绝对/相对容差、NaN和无穷的处理。若一个结果非有限而比较函数只做大于判断，可能意外通过。检查数量、形状、顺序与状态更新，再看数值。本站小型整数/缓存实验应遵循自己的精确语义，不能直接套用GPU浮点容差。
body.en: Specify absolute and relative tolerances and treatment of NaNs and infinities. A comparison that only tests greater-than may accidentally accept non-finite results. body.zh: 超时是终止条件，幂等是重试语义，隔离是权限边界，三者不同。一个子进程即使有timeout，也可能已写文件或启动后代进程；控制器还需确认回收。学习者应画出“提案者能改什么、评估者能读什么、谁能发布”的权限矩阵。

Draw an authority matrix for what the proposer may edit, what the evaluator may read and who may publish.

body.zh: 提交前预留额度，完成后按规则结算；超时与错误也留下记录。并发执行时，先检查剩余额度再扣除必须是同一个受控决策，否则多个worker可能同时认为还有最后一个名额。本课用串行账本练习预留与扣减，生产分布式一致性另需验证。
body.en: Reserve budget before dispatch and settle it under a defined rule afterward; timeouts and errors still leave records. body.zh: 候选运行在较空闲时段、基线运行在高负载时段，会产生假收益。把基线和候选按相邻配对测量，交替顺序并记录原始样本；最终赢家应回到新运行中确认。配对减小环境混杂，但不能自动消除所有偏差。
body.en: A candidate measured when the machine is idle can appear better than a baseline measured under load. Run adjacent baseline/candidate pairs, alternate ordering and retain raw samples; confirm the winner in fresh runs. Pairing reduces environmental confounding but does not eliminate every bias.

body.zh: 说明统计量的定义：比值的平均、时间均值之比、几何均值都不是同一个数。小样本只支持有限结论。确定性模拟适合检查决策逻辑，真实CPU重复计时适合观察噪声；两类记录不要合并计算GPU收益。

title.zh: 原理：为什么需要这一层

body.zh: 正确性和资源上限通常是硬门槛；延迟、吞吐、成本则可能是需要权衡的目标。先过滤不满足门槛的候选，再在可行集合比较。把错误输出的“极速候选”放进Pareto图，会把无效点误当成优秀解。
body.en: Correctness and resource ceilings are often hard constraints; latency, throughput and cost may trade off. Filter infeasible candidates before comparing the feasible set. Including an incorrect but fast candidate on a Pareto plot can make an invalid point look desirable.

body.zh: A在所有需要最小化的指标上不差于B，并至少一项更好，才支配B。多个不互相支配的候选需要业务偏好选择，而不是硬造一个“总分最强”。若使用加权分数，先统一单位并公布权重，避免毫秒与字节直接相加。
body.en: A dominates B only when it is no worse on every minimized metric and strictly better on at least one. Non-dominated candidates require application preferences rather than a universal score. If using weighted scores, normalize units and publish weights instead of directly adding milliseconds to bytes.

body.zh: 教学点A=(10ms,100MiB)，B=(12ms,120MiB)，C=(8ms,150MiB)。A支配B，但不支配C；若内存上限120MiB，C先被排除，再选A。
body.en: For A=(10ms,100MiB), B=(12ms,120MiB), C=(8ms,150MiB), A dominates B but not C. With a 120MiB cap, reject C as infeasible, then select A.

body.zh: 候选可能降低任务量、删困难样本、复用旧输出或修改计时范围来“优化”分数。即便没有恶意，一个开发者也可能无意改了这些条件。检查输入数、输出数、有效工作量、评估器哈希与实际执行路径，才能发现看似漂亮却不可比较的结果。
body.en: Candidates may improve a score by reducing work, dropping hard cases, reusing old outputs or changing timing boundaries. These changes can also happen accidentally. Check input/output counts, effective work, evaluator hashes and execution paths to detect attractive but incomparable results.

body.zh: 评估器不向提案器开放可写权限；最终留出任务也不应成为反复调参的反馈源。仅检查最终分数不够，应保留中间证据和失败原因。遇到规则变动时停止旧排名并重新建基线，不靠“看起来更合理”的解释绕过门禁。
body.en: Do not give the proposer write authority over the evaluator or repeatedly feed final-holdout results into tuning. Retain intermediate evidence and failure reasons instead of only scores. When rules change, stop the old ranking and establish a new baseline rather than explaining away a failed gate.

body.zh: 原来执行100个请求耗100ms，候选只做50个耗60ms。100/60不能叫同任务1.67倍加速；每请求平均反而从1变1.2ms。
body.en: A baseline performs 100 requests in 100ms; a candidate performs only 50 in 60ms. The ratio 100/60 is not 1.67× speedup on the same task; average time per request rises from 1 to 1.2ms.

body.zh: 经验不是一句“batch大更快”，而是带上下文的记录：任务特征、候选、约束、结果、失败原因和证据身份。成功与失败都值得保存，但用途不同。失败用于避免已知无效尝试；成功只能在兼容条件下形成先验，不能跳过新任务验证。
body.en: Experience is contextual evidence, not a slogan such as larger batches are faster. Record task features, candidates, constraints, outcomes, failures and evidence identities. Failures help avoid invalid attempts; successes form priors under compatible conditions, not permission to skip validation on a new task.

body.zh: 先定义兼容性键，例如实现版本、任务族与资源上限，再选择可读取的历史。不要把留出成绩写回提案经验；否则下一次消融不再独立。经验条目还要区分已验证、失败、过期和仅假设，避免一个旧优势永久影响排序。
body.en: Define compatibility keys such as implementation version, task family and resource cap before selecting history. Distinguish verified, failed, stale and hypothetical records so an old result does not permanently bias ranking.

body.zh: 默认4条训练历史包含2条接受记录和2条失败记录（错误输出或内存门槛）。保留4条审计证据，但已验证可用数只能写2；不能把失败的低成本并入成功均值。

title.zh: 原理：为什么需要这一层

body.zh: 单算子优化不等于服务优化。接入vLLM或SGLang后，还涉及排队、KV状态、通信、执行分支和回退。先固定引擎release/commit、模型revision、数据类型、硬件与负载，再确认优化路径确实被执行。没有兼容GPU时，交付设计清单，不编造实测数字。
body.en: A faster operator is not automatically a faster service. In vLLM or SGLang, queueing, KV state, communication, execution branches and fallback also matter. Pin the engine release/commit, model revision, dtype, hardware and workload, then verify that the optimized path actually executes. Without compatible GPUs, deliver a design checklist instead of invented measurements.

body.zh: 分别验证数值、状态和完整生成行为：检查输入是否更新、缓存写入是否正确、重复请求是否读到旧值、不同长度负载是否回退。把正确性与性能记录绑定同一版本。无问芯穹的公开实践属于作者报告，本站课程只借它提出需检查的问题，不宣称复现厂商收益。
body.en: Check numerical values, state and full generation behavior separately: refreshed inputs, valid cache writes, stale outputs across requests and fallback under different lengths. Bind correctness and performance records to the same version. The published Infinigence practice is an author report; this course uses it to frame checks, not to claim reproduction of its gains.

body.zh: Amdahl教学模型：目标环节占40%，该环节快2倍，其余不变，整体speedup=1/(0.6+0.4/2)=1.25倍。若还新增同步，实际收益可能更低。
body.en: Amdahl teaching model: a component consumes 40% of time and becomes twice as fast; the rest is unchanged. Overall speedup is 1/(0.6+0.4/2)=1.25×. Added synchronization may lower the actual benefit.

body.en: Unzip the complete lab and open a terminal in rsi-infra beside lab.py. Each command runs independently of previous outputs. Day20 reruns days1–19; using the same output directory replaces generated files, so use separate directories for comparisons.

expected.zh: 重新生成day01.json至day20.json、REPORT.md和manifest.json。清单包含Python版本、参数、输入/源码与输出哈希；报告中的本人解释仍需自己填写。
expected.en: Regenerates day01.json through day20.json, REPORT.md and manifest.json. The manifest includes Python, arguments and input/source/output hashes; the report still requires your own explanations.

title.zh: 读取原始证据，再解释结果
title.en: Read raw evidence, then explain the result

body.zh: 核对20日JSON、REPORT.md、manifest.json，检查源文件和输入哈希。
body.en: Inspect the following evidence. Inspect all daily JSON records, REPORT.md and manifest identities.

expected.zh: 能读到当天JSON；先核对day、evidence、input_sha256、source_sha256，再按上一步字段解释结果。看到PASS只表示脚本完成，不自动证明你的研究假设。
expected.en: The daily JSON is readable. Check day, evidence, input_sha256 and source_sha256 before interpreting the fields above. PASS means the script completed, not that your research hypothesis was confirmed.

body.zh: 在独立目录交付REPORT.md、20份JSON、manifest及本人改动diff；写清哪些是模型成本、CPU实测和未执行设计。
body.en: Deliver REPORT.md, 20 JSON records, a manifest and your own diff from a fresh directory. Distinguish modeled cost, measured CPU data and unexecuted design.

expected.zh: 交付自己的预测、改动和观察。任何使用--input的变更都从fixtures/workloads.json复制后编辑，保留version及train/validation/holdout结构；用独立输出目录留住原记录。
expected.en: Submit your prediction, change and observation. For --input experiments, copy fixtures/workloads.json and preserve version/train/validation/holdout structure; keep original records in a separate output directory.

symptom.zh: 找不到lab.py或读取不到输入文件
symptom.en: lab.py or an input file cannot be found

fix.zh: 完整解压ZIP后进入含lab.py与fixtures的rsi-infra目录，不要只复制脚本。用python3 --version确认解释器；保存原始报错，先修环境再判断实验。
fix.en: Extract the entire ZIP and enter rsi-infra containing lab.py and fixtures; do not copy only the script. Check python3 --version. Preserve the error and fix the environment before interpreting the experiment.

symptom.zh: 只交截图，不提供原始输出与本人改动
symptom.en: Submitting only screenshots without raw records or your changes

fix.zh: 回到本日机制与原始JSON，检查核对20日JSON、REPORT.md、manifest.json，检查源文件和输入哈希。把无法由记录证明的结论改成待验证假设。
fix.en: Return to the mechanism and raw JSON. Inspect all daily JSON records, REPORT.md and manifest identities. Rephrase claims unsupported by the records as hypotheses to test.

question.zh: 默认实验经验策略没有获益，作品是否一定失败？
question.en: Is the project necessarily a failure if experience brings no benefit?

options.en: Yes; remove data until it wins

options.zh: 不是，可复核的负结果也有工程价值
options.en: No; a reviewable negative result has engineering value

explanation.zh: 评价作品看问题、控制变量、实现、证据和解释；不是只看正向数字。
explanation.en: Evaluate the question, controls, implementation, evidence and interpretation, not only positive numbers.

question.zh: 自己连续运行两次可以写“独立同伴已复现”吗？
question.en: Do two consecutive runs by you justify “independently reproduced by a peer”?

options.zh: 不可以，需要另一人的实际记录
options.en: No; another person’s actual record is needed

explanation.zh: 同一作者重跑证明部分可重复性，不等于独立复现；如实标注证据来源。
explanation.en: Same-author reruns establish some repeatability, not independent reproduction. State the actual source of evidence.
